main.AGENTS.md:
# Ledger App agent guidance

Ledger App is the customer billing portal: invoices, plans, and account settings.

- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Code under `app/billing/` and `db/migrations/` moves money or stored data. Treat it as sensitive.
- Customer-facing views live in `app/views/`.

415.title: Mid-cycle downgrades break the invoice step
415.body:
Downgrading mid-cycle makes `prorate` return a negative amount, and the invoice step fails.
A plan change after the period ended throws instead of charging nothing.

## Verification

- A mid-cycle downgrade charges $0.00, proven by a test.
- A change after the period ended charges $0.00, proven by a test.

441.title: Fix proration on mid-cycle downgrades
441.body: Fixes #415. A mid-cycle downgrade charged a negative amount and failed the invoice step, and a change after the period ended threw. Both now charge $0.00. Adds tests for both.
441.author: dana-acme
